train_test_subject_overlap.reason: subject id not inferable from every split file name; subject independence cannot be verified from artifacts

segment_overlap.reason: per-window segment arrays are not persisted; overlapping segments between splits cannot be detected from artifacts

electrode_selection_test_leakage.basis: Phase 4 selection ranked electrodes from the training split only (code audit); stored top_5/top_4 cross-checked against the Phase 6 montage lists

normalization_test_leakage.basis: per-channel z-score statistics computed by dataset.compute_training_stats() on the training recordings only, then applied to validation/test (code audit)

threshold_test_leakage.basis: classification threshold fixed at the constant evaluate.DEFAULT_THRESHOLD = 0.5; never tuned on any split (code audit)

class_weight_leakage.basis: balanced class weights computed by train.compute_class_weights() from training labels only (code audit)
